capabilities: insert Are.na blocks into the current note
save Are.na blocks locally as notes
display Are.na blocks in notes bidirectionally
open Are.na blocks in the browser
extras: A personal access token is only needed to save private blocks; public blocks work without one. Notes are stored locally in an are.na folder with the block id as the file name.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to save Are.na blocks as notes or view them in the vault.

relations.evidence: login with your Are.na account (this is the official Are.na API)

summary: Are.na integration that saves Are.na blocks as local notes and displays them inside your vault.
